definitions.explanation: Blocking or reflecting radiant heat, especially sunlight, to keep a space cooler. Common in building materials, paints, and films designed to reduce solar heat gain.

examples.japanese: {遮熱|しゃねつ}シートを{張|は}る。
この{塗料|とりょう}には{遮熱|しゃねつ}{効果|こうか}がある。
examples.english: This paint has a heat-shielding effect.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}に{遮熱|しゃねつ}フィルムを{貼|は}ると{室温|しつおん}の{上昇|じょうしょう}を{抑|おさ}えられる。
examples.english: Applying heat-shielding film to the windows can curb the rise in room temperature.

notes:
Reflecting or blocking radiant heat (mainly sunlight) before it enters a space. Distinct from {断熱|だんねつ}, which slows heat transfer through a material.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遮熱|しゃねつ}{塗料|とりょう}: heat-shielding paint
- {遮熱|しゃねつ}フィルム: heat-shielding film
- {遮熱|しゃねつ}{効果|こうか}: heat-shielding effect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {断熱|だんねつ}: insulation — slows heat moving through walls and materials; {遮熱|しゃねつ} reflects radiant heat away before it enters
